name: @spark901/civic-source-swagit
description: Town-agnostic Swagit meeting-list + transcript-fetch client. TypeScript port of the Python proof-of-concept scripts in personal-work/goals/collierville-civic-data-poc/scripts/ — same endpoints, same parsing rules, same gotchas. Takes a Swagit portal + board config and returns a meeting list, raw transcripts, and structured (agenda-item/timestamp-parsed) transcripts, so a second Swagit-hosted town is a new config value, not new code. Not published to a registry — no build step; consumers import the TypeScript source directly.
